verdict.rationale:
Steel is API-first and ships a CLI, Docker image (API+UI), and Sessions API that spins up isolated cloud browsers on demand, all designed to be driven programmatically with no GUI required — exactly the shape needed for CI/headless automation. It also supports standard automation clients (Puppeteer/Playwright/Selenium via CDP) which are routinely run headlessly in CI pipelines.

Missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) or independent report confirming real-world headless CI usage.
